svg.title: c-VEP brain–computer interface selecting silos in a VR mining scenario
svg.text: Selecting a silo with your mind
Each target flickers in its own binary code (c-VEP). The EEG locks onto the one you look at.
Unity · C# · Unicorn EEG · Meta Quest Pro — tested with 26 people · ICEIS 2025 · SVR 2025
